statement: Let N, n, µ ≥ 1 and h ≥ 0 be integers. Suppose that P ∈ C[x1, . . . , xN ] is a coefficientwise limit of determinants of n × n matrices of affine-linear forms. Let Ψ : Ch+1 → CN be an affine map and w1, . . . , wh ∈ CN constant directions. If P(Ψ(ξ)) = 0, (∂wi P)(Ψ(ξ)) = 0 (1 ≤ i ≤ h) (8.3) has at least µ distinct simple zeros, then µ ≤ [Hh+1 Un−1 V n−1 ](H + U)n (H + V )n−1 (U + V )h (8.4) ≤ 2h 2n − 1 h + 1 ! , n ≥ h + 1 4e µ1/(h+1) . (8.5) The binomial coefficient is zero if h + 1 > 2n − 1.
